# Knowledge Base: erdos-1027-oq-03

## Problem Understanding

OQ-03 from Erdős #1027 asks whether good sets can be found constructively via the Moser-Tardos algorithm. The answer is YES for families satisfying nm + 1 ≤ 2^{n-3}.

## Insights

- The LLL condition 2/2^n · (nm+1) ≤ 1/4 gives a constructive bound
- The bound is weaker than Erdős's classical bound by factor ~4n
- The trade-off is constructiveness: MT algorithm finds good sets efficiently
- Expected runtime is 1/n — essentially one random attempt suffices

## Completed

Full formalization with 17 sorry-free, axiom-free theorems.
